stem.text: Cigarette smoke contains carbon monoxide, nicotine and tar.
Which row correctly describes how these substances affect the body?

A.text: stimulates nerve endings; stimulates the nervous system to reduce the diameter of the arteries; leads to obstructive lung disease

B.text: forms carbaminohaemoglobin; increases the risk of blood clots; blocks goblet cells

C.text: causes increased blood pressure; combines with haemoglobin; increases the risk of blood clots

D.text: combines with haemoglobin; stimulates nerve endings; carcinogenic
